messages:
zack.h: Noticed a set of invoices from the 2026-06-01 midday run missing GPU compute lines and a few with duplicated invoice IDs (same invoice number, two objects in S3). Example: inv_02021m (orbitlabs) — PDF sent, but total looks low.
lee.m: Which pipeline executed? new "fast-emit" or standard daily?
zack.h: Fast-emit `fast-emit-2026-06-01-12z`. Logs show emit completed before the async `usage-merge` finished. Snippet: 
```
[12:04:05] invoice-emit: emitInvoice(inv_02021m) -> EMITTED total=1,980.00 items=3
[12:04:06] usage-merge: mergeUsage(inv_02021m) -> COMPLETED added_rows=5
```
That ordering implies missing rows at emit time.
billing-bot: Alert: 14 invoices flagged: missing_expected_sku(compute.gpu); 4 invoices flagged: duplicate_s3_keys_for_invoice. Full report uploaded -> s3://billing/alerts/2907654321/report.json
tanya.p: Audit asked for escalation because one invoice increases by +$12,300 after reconcile. We need finance approval for changes over $6,000 per current policy.
ops: Likely race between fast-emit flow and merge worker. Fast-emit intentionally doesn't wait for merge to finish for latency reasons but we didn't guard for late-arriving usage. We'll need a short-term mitigation.
lee.m: Proposal: 1) Pause outbound email for run `fast-emit-2026-06-01-12z` immediately. 2) Run a dry-run reconcile: `billingctl reconcile --batch fast-emit-2026-06-01-12z --dry-run --out s3://billing/recons/dry-2907654321.csv`. 3) For invoices with delta <= $6k auto-apply backfill+re-emit; for > $6k route to finance-approvals.
finance-approvals: Please provide statement of approval for deltas > $6k. We'll attach usage proofs.
billing-bot: Dry-run started at 2907654370. Current status: in-progress. Partial results: 14 affected; deltas range -$55 to +$12,300; 2 invoices exceed $6k. Dry-run CSV path (partial): s3://billing/recons/dry-2907654321-partial.csv
zack.h: Also noticed duplicate PDFs: looks like pdf-worker retried after a 504 and re-uploaded without using idempotency token. For those 4 invoices there are two S3 objects under the same invoice key with different etags. Support has already received one inbound ticket about duplicate attachments.
ops: Quick fix: disable outbound-email for this batch, and patch pdf-worker to check invoice state+idempotency key before upload. I'll open a PR for a 1-line guard and a retry-window setting. Can canary in staging today.
lee.m: For re-emit decisions: We will mark affected invoices DRAFT, apply backfill, then `emit --batch ... --no-email` for QA. After verification, re-send PDFs for invoices <= $6k. For ones > $6k hold and send finance-approvals package.
finance-approvals: Please expect a package from ops with usage CSVs and raw meter events for the two >$6k cases. We'll need sign-off before re-sending.
tanya.p: Support: prepare customer outreach for the two high-delta customers and a standard notification for the rest. Save templates to /docs/support/reissue-fast-emit-2026-06-01.md.
zack.h: I kicked off the dry-run reconcile at 2907654370. Will post the consolidated CSV when complete. Also, we should add a monitoring alert to catch emits where line_item_count < expected_count_by_customer_profile within 60s of emit.
billing-bot: Dry-run complete at 2907654620. Output: s3://billing/recons/dry-2907654321.csv. Summary: 12 invoices delta <= $6k, 2 invoices delta > $6k (orbitlabs + heliovex).
ops: Action items assigned: 1) Pause email send (done). 2) Backfill+re-emit <= $6k (automated). 3) Bundle > $6k to finance-approvals (tanya). 4) Patch pdf-worker idempotency (lee). 5) Add emit-vs-usage guard and alert (ops).
finance-approvals: Please review orbitlabs packet (s3://billing/approvals/orbitlabs-2907654321.zip) and heliovex packet (s3://billing/approvals/heliovex-2907654321.zip).
finance-approvals: Received. We'll review within the day. If approved, route back to ops to re-emit and cap invoices with explanatory footnote.
zack.h: Will run backfill for the 12 approved invoices now and re-emit with `--no-email` for QA. I'll attach the backfill log once finished. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
